headline: Modal Labs, a company that rents out computing power for AI work, has raised $750 million and is now valued at $15.75 billion.
score_reason: Pool score 7 kept: a large round with a valuation that more than tripled in five months.
importance_line: Developers who rent AI computing and rival cloud firms are affected, though the revenue and speed figures are Modal's own claims.
summary: SiliconANGLE reports that Modal Labs, which rents out computing power for training and running AI models, raised $750 million in a Series D round led by Accel and now has a value of $15.75 billion, more than triple its value after its May round. The company says its yearly revenue has more than tripled since May to over $1 billion, a figure that comes from Modal itself, and that it will fund new services for training AI models after their first round of learning.
